feat(edm): sinker burn to depth with a single electrode

A sinker electrode tool kind (ToolKind::Electrode): diameter = face X,
width = face Y, flute_len = length below the holder, shank_len = pickup
offset; rpm 0 and a sharp face by law, refused by name at AddTool /
ChangeTool / the library reader. EDM-E10X6 joins the starter catalog.

The Sinker Burn op (OpType 41, Section::Sinker, Family::Sinker) runs on
a sinker EDM only - refused by name elsewhere. Depth is read from a
stated datum (work top, cavity floor stand-off, electrode tip at the
approach plane); a burn past the cavity floor datum, past the model's
floor, or deeper than the electrode is long is refused by name. The
machine condition's spark gap (#531, Gap only, after the sinker-kind
check) places the tip one gap above the floor. CL: approach rapid, one
feed plunge, rapid retract; golden tests/golden/sinker_burn_cavity.cl.

Verification (#290 D7): the column engine's box atom (simulate_box)
sweeps the face grown by the gap; the program verdict convicts a burn
deeper than the part's cavity. The field eye refuses an electrode by
name (no box atom there yet). The stamp digests the resolved gap.
MCP drives it through add_tool / add_operation / edit_operation /
generate / undo; a minimal op page keeps the tab law. No post (#542).

Not exercised on a real EDM control.

Fixes #541

feat(edm): sinker orbit patterns (circular, vector, planetary) as explicit moves

A Sinker Burn can now orbit at the burn floor. After the plunge, the
electrode's circular, vector or planetary excursion is expanded into
explicit Feed chords (#290 D3), so the 3-axis stock sim's box atom
verifies every move that posts, corner joins included. Every vertex
lies on or inside the stated radius, so no move overshoots it. The
circle's vertices include the four axis directions, so a rectangular
electrode's cavity widens by exactly the radius.

The pattern must be one the setup's sinker lists under edm.orbits, and
the radius must be within its stated edm.max_orbit_radius (#290 D6).
Both fields come from the #530 schema and are unchanged here. Each is
refused by name at generation, and an unstated maximum is refused
rather than read as unlimited. The orbit is an additive op field and
file key, so a plain plunge keeps its CL and digest. MCP reaches it
through the params JSON door. No new command.

Pinned by tests/sinker_orbit.rs (golden sinker_orbit_circular.cl) and
motion::sinker_orbit unit tests. Not exercised on a real EDM control.

Fixes #544

feat(edm): sinker side burn - a lateral electrode move that burns one wall out by a stated amount

A separate op kind, Sinker Side Burn (stored id 42): the Sinker Burn's
plunge with its own condition, then one Feed along +X/-X/+Y/-Y at the
floor and back. Its own electrode undersize with the condition's spark
gap bounds the move: allowance = undersize - gap; a move past it (a move
into the part), a gap the undersize can't honour, an unknown condition,
a non-finite/zero/negative amount and an orbit are refused by name at
command creation (create, paste, edit, retype) and again at generation.
The box atom sweeps every move; MCP through the params JSON door;
additive file variant. CL golden sinker_side_burn.cl.

Not exercised on a real EDM control.
